title: EvalAssist: A Human-Centered Tool for LLM-as-a-Judge

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting evaluations twice with the options or outputs presented in different, shuffled orders to determine if the LLM evaluator's decision changes based solely on the position of the text rather than its content.
Addressed by allowing users to select from multiple model-agnostic LLM evaluators, preventing a single model from systematically favoring its own generated responses.
